query: My employer terminated me without paying my wages.

request_payload.text: My employer terminated me without paying my wages.

response_body.normalized_text: My employer terminated me without paying my wages.
response_body.rights_explanation:
According to Section 17 of The Code on Wages, 2019, your employer is required to pay you within two working days if they have dismissed or removed you from service. Therefore, if your employer terminated your employment without paying your wages, you are entitled to receive the unpaid wages within this period.

Section 45 of The Code on Wages, 2019 also states that if an employer fails to pay the wages as required by Section 17 or any other relevant section, a certificate can be issued by an authority. This certificate allows the Collector or District Magistrate to recover the unpaid wages from your employer.

Relevant Act and Section Citations:
- The Code on Wages, 2019, Section 17
- The Code on Wages, 2019, Section 45

query: I was injured because of a defective product.

request_payload.text: I was injured because of a defective product.

response_body.normalized_text: I was injured because of a defective product.
response_body.rights_explanation:
According to The Consumer Protection Act, 2019, Section 84, if you were injured due to a defective product, the manufacturer of that product may be liable for your harm. This liability can arise from several circumstances including:
- The presence of a manufacturing defect in the product.
- Defective design of the product.
- Deviation from specified manufacturing standards.
- Failure of the product to meet express warranties.
- Absence of adequate instructions or warnings regarding correct usage that could prevent injury.

This section establishes the manufacturer's liability even if they can prove they were not negligent or fraudulent in making any express warranty about the product. However, for further details on what actions you may take and the specific remedies available, it is advisable to consult a legal professional.

Relevant Act and Section Citations:
- The Consumer Protection Act, 2019
- Section 84 - Harm Caused To Him On Account Of A Defective Product
